title: Memory Beyond One Session
summary: Work through Memory Beyond One Session.

blocks.md: This lesson follows **Memory Beyond One Session** in *Long-Term Memory* (Vol III).

blocks.source: Vol III, Long-Term Memory, § Memory Beyond One Session
blocks.md: Consider the repair agent (a later section) working on its connection-pool defect across several sessions. When the initial session terminates, the subsequent run must reconstruct the operational state: the candidate source tree at revision `r18`, the diagnostic failure observed at `r17`, the passing run of `test_waiter_notified_on_return`, the integration checks that remain unresolved, and an operational note indicating where to resume execution. None of this state survives inside a transient context window once the process exits. Persisting only the final summary message discards critical supporting evidence.

blocks.prompt: Think first: In two or three sentences, explain why Record roles matters for the system this section describes.
blocks.md: Compare your answer with the book's claim: Persistent records are roles in an evidence chain (source of record, observation log, agent-written memory, retrieval index), not storage tiers, and any claim is validated against its source of record.

questions.q: The section **Memory Beyond One Session** develops one of the chapter's claims. Which one?
options: Repeated retrieval or re-summarization adds no independent evidence, so preventing a withdrawn or unverified claim from persisting needs a provenance graph over derived records whose invalidation cascades.
A retrieval index is a materialized view that cannot be maintained by deltas, so each derived entry carries a source generation and the gateway admits it only for the generations it is valid in.

The unit of evaluation is the whole memory policy run through isolated multi-session trials with lifecycle fixtures, scored by task acceptance and cost per accepted task including background maintenance.

Persistent records are roles in an evidence chain (source of record, observation log, agent-written memory, retrieval index), not storage tiers, and any claim is validated against its source of record.
